statement: ∀ (N X : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : ℕ → ℝ), X+2 < N → (∀ n, X < n → f n=0) → (∑ j : ZMod N, f j.val * f (j+2).val) = (Finset.range (X+1)).sum (fun n => f n*f (n+2))
